title: optimize-quant-kernels-int8-fp8-smoothquant-dequant-fusion-kvcache-scheduling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Reduce tail latency and increase sustained throughput for quantized models served by Redwood runtime. This PR implements several coordinated improvements to INT8/FP8 kernels and the dequant/fusion paths (smoothquant-aware), improves KV cache access patterns, and adjusts continuous-batching and scheduler heuristics to better exploit quantized kernels. Summary of changes: 1) Kernel refactor: reorganized matmul/transpose kernels for int8 and fp8 paths to improve memory access locality and vectorization. 2) SmoothQuant integration: added per-channel scaling propagation into the quantized fused path so we can fuse dequant+matmul without extra memory copies while preserving accuracy. 3) Dequant fusion: introduced a fast fused dequant->gemm path that avoids materializing full fp32 tensors when possible; supports fallback for edge cases. 4) KV cache scheduling: reduced lock contention by introducing per-shard read batching and prefetch hints from the batching layer. 5) Continuous batching: updated heuristics to prioritize requests that benefit most from quantized kernels (longer sequences, higher token throughput), and tightened latency SLO guardrails for small requests. 6) Tests and benchmarks: end-to-end perf canary, unit tests for quant scales, and new regression prompts to catch numeric drift. Performance: internal perf canary on A100 and H100 quantized models shows median latency -18% and throughput +25% on 1k-token workload; memory footprint reduced ~12% for batched inferences. Accuracy: evaluated on the eval harness with representative prompts; numeric drift within expected bounds (max 0.6% BLEU-equivalent difference for tested ops). Checklist: - [x] Kernel microbenchmarks - [x] End-to-end perf canary - [x] Unit tests - [x] CI green - [x] Reviewer approvals. Related: refactors and follow-ups include ENG-4912 (scheduler tuning) and SUP-1124 (customer incident root-cause).

Reliability: safer fused dequant path with explicit fallbacks. Action: No customer-facing API change; rollout gated behind canary and feature flag 'quant_fastpath' which is off by default.
notes_for_release_team: Gate rollout under 'quant_fastpath' feature flag; coordinate with infra to enable perf canary on H100/A100 clusters; observe eval-harness regression alerts for the first 48 hours.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: small numeric drift for extreme quantization configs; Mitigation: fallback to reference dequant path if per-channel scaling variance exceeds threshold; added regression prompts and monitoring to detect regressions.
